title: Three Weeks and One Short Basket
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：sale　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sale 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the trader ① made the sale that no partner in the market would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the week. The ② sale, meaning the trade itself and not the basket, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a sale, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sale in that market had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ sale at the far stall, meaning the sample they kept for the children to show and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sale, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the trader said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sale was the whole of the matter, meaning the gain and not the trade. The ⑥ sale, meaning the gain and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; sale, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a trade and a gain. He said the gain is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ sale had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ sale of the whole thing, the trader wrote in October, was one market and three weeks of describing; sale, he said, is either the sample at the far stall or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sale I remember is the trade described in the list, which closed in 1994 and is still described as the quietest in the market. A ⑩ sale, my mother said in 1996, is the only trade that improves by being described; every sale, she said, is a gain that has agreed to look like a trade. She said the gain was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 销售；特价（指集市里每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 销售；特价（指那笔销售本身，与小小的货篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the sale 做成这一笔销售
D. n. 销售；特价（指留给孩子们给人看的那一份）
E. n. 销售之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的销售之事）
F. n. 销售；特价（指货单里写到、被描述的那一笔）
G. n. 销售、进账（指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 进账（抽象总称，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the sale that no partner in the market would have described
The sale, meaning the trade itself and not the basket
the sale at the far stall
the sale was the whole of the matter
the sale had become a line in a list
The sale of the whole thing
A sale, my mother said in 1996

answers.why: make the sale 意为“做成这一笔销售”，1987 年那位货商把集市里没有一位伙计肯描述的一笔销售做了一遍。
sale 意为“销售；特价”，指那笔销售本身而不是小小的货篮，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
sale 意为“销售；特价”，指集市里每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一只小小的货篮。
sale 意为“销售；特价”，指最远那个摊子的留给孩子们给人看的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sale 意为“销售、进账”，指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔进账就是那件事的全部。
sale 意为“进账”，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔销售，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sale 意为“销售；特价”，指货单里写到、被描述的那一笔，到 1992 年这一笔成了货单里的一行。
sale 意为“销售之事”，货商十月写道，整件事的销售之事是一处集市和三个星期的描述。
sale 意为“销售；特价”，我记得的是货单里描述过的那一笔，1994 年批完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一笔。
sale 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，销售是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的销售。
